'''Revelation Lightning Watto''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Revelation]]
* '''Published:''' 16 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' No Money, No Parts, No Deal!
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 NMNPND Revelation DS 2003 Lightnin 4172.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Fast Watto.

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

Turn one: Take Reegesk into hand, flip with him and Watto, count your evasion cards in reserve, and draw until you get a barrier. Second turn: Take Dannik Jerriko, put him with Watto, reinforce Reegesk with somebody. Cool? This is an early damage deck- either beatdown early, or force drain early. Beatsquads can force drain too, you know. but this is mainly a beatdown deck. I like expanding the junkyard to deploy Watto from reserve two more times- you can also expand the AC if you want. Ability x3 is way cool, No Escape is important, just like Reactor Terminal. Destiny?s a little low, but not too bad, but that?s why I have a Colo Claw Fish, +for Bossk. I call this ?Lightning Watto? because it?s such a fast deck. I don?t use (V) Jerriko because I like the non-V one better?simple, okay? I play with 4 Twi?leks so I can get No Escape whenever I want to, and so also I can pull cool effects like I just mentioned. Cantina is for draining, AC is to get an important alien when you need him. Do I need to explain anything else?

Matchups:

TIGIH: Well, you?re both beatdown decks?track your barriers and redraw them!

MWYHL: Do a great amount of early damage and play CHYBC so he can?t retrieve 10 once he flips. Try to win before he flips, because once he does, you?re in trouble.

WYS: You?re both Tatooine- take over.

Profit: You?re both Tatooine- take over.

HB: Early damage, try to make him lose systems off the top.

RTP: If he?s playing multiple-Leia RTP, use Dannik to get rid of her. Against Bacta Tank RTP, use Bossk to capture her. DON?T let him get Watto out of play!

I don?t really have a clue for anything else.Just do your Watto thing.
